name: Seal Bay Aquatic Reserve
reason: Offshore marine reserve at Seal Bay; the visit is Seal Bay Conservation Park (Wikivoyage lists it separately). Duplicate of Seal Bay.

name: Vivonne Bay Conservation Park
reason: Coastal heath park west of Vivonne Bay; searched parks.sa.gov.au, Wikivoyage, tourism board: no visitor page for the park itself, part of it is closed 1 May-31 Dec each year, and the draw (Vivonne Bay beach/jetty, Harriet River) is a separate spot. Duplicate of Vivonne Bay.

name: Pelican Lagoon Conservation Park
reason: Park on the lagoon's north shore with no visitor facilities or named walk found; tourism board and Wikivoyage name Pelican Lagoon (lookout, sanctuary) not the park. Duplicate of Pelican Lagoon.

name: Middle River Dam
reason: Reservoir with no visitor page in Wikivoyage, tourism board or southaustralia.com; searched all three.

name: Cuttlefish Bay
reason: Wikivoyage only gives it as the address locality of Dudley Wines (a cellar door, not a spot); no counted source names the bay as a place to go.

name: Beyeria Conservation Park
reason: Searched parks.sa.gov.au, Wikivoyage, tourism board and web: no visitor page, walk or facility; small bush park not named as somewhere to go.

name: Cape Bouguer Wilderness Protection Area
reason: Wilderness area with no facilities; only mentions found are the multi-day Wilderness Trail (an operator-run walk) and a Hanson Bay day walk passing through it. Searched parks.sa.gov.au, Wikivoyage, tourism board; no counted source names the area as a stop.

name: Cape Torrens Wilderness Protection Area
reason: Remote, seasonally closed, 4WD-only wilderness protection area; no visitor page naming a walk or lookout in it found at parks.sa.gov.au, tourism board or Wikivoyage.

name: Western River Wilderness Protection Area
reason: For: the tourism board names a track in it to Billy Goat Falls (winter falls) and Western River Cove camp ground with a beach. Against: remote, single counted source, falls flow seasonally, and the real draws (Billy Goat Falls, Western River Cove) would be better spots than the protected-area label; no agency page found.

name: Cygnet Estuary Conservation Park
reason: Estuary park near Kingscote with no visitor facilities; searched parks.sa.gov.au, Wikivoyage, tourism board and web: no counted source names it as somewhere to go.

name: Nepean Bay Conservation Park
reason: 32 ha coastal sandplain remnant with no named walk or facility found; no counted source names it as somewhere to go.

name: Mount Taylor Conservation Park
reason: Bushland park; searched parks.sa.gov.au, Wikivoyage and tourism board: no visitor page, walk or lookout named.

name: Dudley Conservation Park
reason: Mallee park on the Dudley Peninsula; the only visitor material found is the proposed Dudley Trail (master plan, not an existing walk). No counted source names the park as a stop.

name: Simpson Conservation Park
reason: Small bushland park; searched parks.sa.gov.au, Wikivoyage and tourism board: no visitor source, walk or facility.

name: Seddon Conservation Park
reason: Small bushland park; searched parks.sa.gov.au, Wikivoyage and tourism board: no visitor source, walk or facility.

name: Parndana Conservation Park
reason: Small bushland park; Wikivoyage names Parndana only for supplies and the Wildlife Park (a separate attraction). No visitor source for the park.

name: Bales Beach Aquatic Reserve
reason: Marine reserve; Wikivoyage mentions Bales Bay only as a south-coast beach. No separate visit; duplicate of any Bales Beach spot.

name: American River Aquatic Reserve
reason: Abolished in 2016 (now Pelican Lagoon Sanctuary Zone in Encounter Marine Park); not a separate place to visit. Duplicate of Pelican Lagoon.
